preparation: Only original client/API/CLI/MCP, the existing actual HTTP/stdio receiving example, the issue55 author contract and current primary Calendar Events documentation were read. No agenda candidate implementation or author tests have been read.
native_runtime: Actual installed HTTPX/MCP and their declared dependencies in /dev/shm/e827-canvaspilot-agenda-runtime; no browser, remote account, real token or substitute package.

expected.record_rule: Every full record equals its source JSON value, including identities/types, nested overrides, literal text, unknown flags and original timestamps. Course binding resolves section91 to selected course61. Duplicate assignment_801 records stay distinct by source index. No fallback to nested assignment.due_at, midnight, host time zone or local date refiltering.
expected.page_rule: Two real HTTP pages per collection. First requests carry exact normalized context filters and inclusive date strings. Next links contain only opaque percent-encoded cursor queries; original filters must not be appended to the continuation. GET only, synthetic bearer only, loopback only.

cases.name: actual_cli_complete_agenda
cases.purpose: Real native CLI/HTTPX/paginator emits the ten-record agenda, exact fractional UTC order and complete source records; successful empty collections remain distinguishable from refusals.

cases.name: actual_cli_complete_refusal
variants: foreign context on final assignment page
cases.purpose: No successful partial stdout; structured input/provider error; invalid selection before HTTP; no writes, browser profile or retry of repeated pages.

cases.name: registered_mcp_stdio_and_recovery
cases.purpose: Actual installed MCP client initializes the actual server, reads the advertised tool/readonly annotations, calls the agenda, receives an explicit failure after late provider refusal, then successfully calls again with fresh complete records. Original source/fixtures remain unchanged. Tool argument spelling follows the author's declared public signature, not implementation internals.

acceptance_boundaries: Baseline missing-route/missing-tool results are expected negative evidence, not Canvas transport failures.
The inherited paginator admits a terminal single JSON object as one record; this receiver will not call that an agenda-level collection-shape guarantee.
Known timed ordering uses exact UTC comparison finer than Python datetime microseconds; equal times need only stable source order where specified.
All-day date and timing-unavailable groups stay separate from instants; output is a sequential read result, not a simultaneous course snapshot.
No live Canvas account, browser-broker session, attendance/submission interpretation, learner benefit or persistent file export is exercised.
Source review occurs after frozen receiving. Any test contract correction keeps the original protocol/code/log and exact successor separate.
